notes.title: "natsuno-kanata" Content Update Completed !
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing "natsuno-kanata".

With ver. 1.2.10, we are pleased to announce that all updates scheduled for "natsuno-kanata" have been completed,
We are pleased to announce that all scheduled updates for "natsuno-kanata" have been completed with the release of ver1.2.10.
It has been about a year since the full release and nearly two years since the start of early access, so thank you very much for your support.
Thanks to the many people who have played the game, we are now ready for the last update.
For those of you who have not yet played the game, we hope you will take this opportunity to do so.

This will be the last update related to the contents.
We will continue to work on fixing bugs as needed.

We will consider porting "natsuno-kanata" to other platforms and localizing it in other languages.
We will also be releasing the soundtrack, which has not yet been made public, on YouTube.
Please follow our official Twitter account and stay tuned.
https://twitter.com/natsu_no_kanata

Even though the update is over, their journey will continue.
Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: natsuno-kanata Full Release
notes.notes:
We have released the early access version of natsuno-kanata since August 5, 2021.
We are pleased to announce the release of the full version (ver. 1.0.0) of the text adventure game natsuno-kanata.

The main additions in the full version are as follows.
Addition of a scenario up to the conclusion of the game.
Addition of two new character episodes.
Additional locations, items, etc.


Thank you to everyone who played the Early Access version.
We hope you continue to enjoy the full version.


Although the early access period has ended, we will continue to update natsuno-kanata regularly.
In addition to adjustments and bug fixes, we plan to add episodes that can be viewed after the ending.
Detailed updates will be released at a later date.

We look forward to your continued feedback and requests.

notes.title: August 18, 2022 Full Release! & Theme Song MV Release Announcement

The full release date of the text ADV natsuno-kanata, which has been available on Steam since August 5, 2021, has been decided.

notes.title: natsuno-kanata Full Version will be released in the summer of 2022
notes.notes:
natsuno-kanata has been released in Early Access since August 5, 2021.
The release date of the full version has been decided!


natsuno-kanata Full Version

　Summer 2022

The full version will be released on Steam in the summer of 2022. 


We are working hard on it, so please wait for a while.


The save data from the Early Access version will be carried over to the Full Version.
　If you have enjoyed the early access version, you can play the full version without any modification.

natsuno-kanata will be available for free even after the full version is released.
　There are no plans for DLC or other paid content.
